name: Tropical kit
body:
Source Heroes of the Wild pg. 9
Price 120 gp; Weight 6 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit is intended for hot and moist environments such as jungles and warm marshes. It includes 1 dose each of antiplagueUE and antitoxin, five fishhooks, a hammockUE, a kukri, 1 dose of vermin repellentUE, and a water purification spongeUE.
